ledger: Skateboarder | Black t-shirt, dark pants, green socks, red shoes | Black t-shirt, dark pants, green socks, red shoes | Severe anatomical morphing of the right leg during the second jump landing.

findings.description: During the mid-air portion and landing of the second trick, the character's right leg undergoes severe anatomical distortion, with the lower leg bending backward at an impossible angle before reforming upon landing.
